attempts.result: {"status": "done", "summary": "PR3 code review complete. 22 automated tests pass and local HTTP acceptance passes per VALIDATION.md. Five confirmed code-level defects identified; six follow-up items remain open from TASK_BOARD and are confirmed unimplemented in current code. Browser/mobile acceptance is unverified \u2014 no browser tool is available in this environment.", "findings": ["DEFECT \u2014 SQL injection pattern in dashboard (main.py:657-698): six SQL queries use f-string-interpolated WHERE clauses built from report_window() output (e.g. `where = f\"created_at >= '{start}'...\"`) rather than parameterized bindings. Values are currently internal and not user-controlled, so no practical exploitation path today, but the pattern is unsafe and would become exploitable if report_window() were ever tainted (e.g. via the monkeypatch path exercised in test_delivery_report_uses_delivery_day). courier_page (lines 548-556) correctly uses parameterized ? placeholders for the same timestamps \u2014 the inconsistency is the defect.", "DEFECT \u2014 TOCTOU race in confirmer_edit_item and confirmer_add_item (main.py:359-427): _require_state() (called at lines 366 and 400) opens a separate DB connection and reads order status, then the handler opens a second connection and issues BEGIN IMMEDIATE. The state check and lock acquisition are not atomic; a concurrent transition could change status in the gap, causing the handler to proceed on stale information even though it re-checks status inside the transaction.", "DEFECT \u2014 kitchen_ready missing explicit ROLLBACK (main.py:471-485): issues BEGIN IMMEDIATE but has no except/ROLLBACK path in its finally block, relying on implicit SQLite rollback on connection close. All other multi-step transactional handlers (confirmer_approve, dispatch_assign, courier_delivered, confirmer_edit_item, confirmer_add_item) have explicit ROLLBACK in their except blocks. The inconsistency is the defect; if orders.transition() raises StateError the transaction state is silently discarded.", "DEFECT \u2014 CRM address overwritten on every unconfirmed call (main.py:791-795): _submit_call_payload unconditionally updates a returning customer's name, street, house_number, plz, city, and notes from caller-supplied values before the order is confirmed. A caller with a victim's phone number can silently overwrite their stored address. The order_contacts snapshot (line 837) is written correctly and is isolated from later CRM changes, but the CRM record itself is corrupted immediately. TASK_BOARD item 2 acknowledges the UI gap but the pre-confirmation CRM mutation is an unguarded write.", "DEFECT \u2014 Starlette/HTTPX deprecation warning unresolved: one deprecation warning emitted during the 22-test run (documented in CURRENT_STATE.md and VALIDATION.md). Not a test failure but signals an API incompatibility that will become a failure on a future dependency upgrade. Exact warning text not captured in this review.", "FOLLOW-UP \u2014 Browser/mobile acceptance unverified: no browser tool is available in this review environment. CURRENT_STATE.md and VALIDATION.md both explicitly state that browser demo at kitchen/courier mobile widths, form/network error feedback, and retry UI remain unverified. This review cannot change that status.", "FOLLOW-UP \u2014 No CSRF synchronizer tokens (TASK_BOARD item 4): all state-mutating forms rely solely on Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site header checks (main.py:68-71). The base.html logout form and all POST forms emit no anti-CSRF token. Header-based checks are bypassed by non-browser HTTP clients and are not sufficient for pilot use.", "FOLLOW-UP \u2014 No login throttling (TASK_BOARD item 4, VALIDATION.md): /login POST has no rate limiting, lockout, or delay. Credential brute-force is unrestricted.", "FOLLOW-UP \u2014 Failed-delivery recovery UI absent (TASK_BOARD item 5): courier_failed route (main.py:633-644) transitions to failed_delivery state, but no UI exists to reassign or cancel from that state. TRANSITIONS map (orders.py:18) shows failed_delivery -> {assigned, cancelled, closed} but no handler exposes this to the courier or dispatcher.", "FOLLOW-UP \u2014 Order-specific address correction UI absent (TASK_BOARD item 2): confirmer_review and call simulator provide no way to correct the delivery address for a specific in-flight order without also altering the customer's CRM record (see DEFECT above). The snapshot isolation works correctly but the correction workflow is missing.", "FOLLOW-UP \u2014 Migration and concurrent-load testing not performed (TASK_BOARD item 3): no test verifies schema migration from the pre-hardening DB (missing order_contacts, submissions tables). Historical contact snapshots for pre-existing orders default to current CRM data at migration time. SQLite single-writer WAL behavior under concurrent confirmer/kitchen/courier updates is untested."]}
